criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame is a txbench relief. Frame 7 is close to the showstopper, frames 6 and 8 are solid. Frames 4 and 5 are grey bars on a graph-paper lattice, frames 2 and 3 have no subject at feed size, frame 1's coat is matte slate, a different surface from frame 7's glaze. One skeleton on all nine.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One key, one bench, one ember accent. Three continuity devices work, the panorama counts 37 across 2 and 3, the terrace leaves frame 4 and ends at 21 on 5, the T cell motif changes state. The palette strobes between warm tissue and cold grey hardware on 2 to 5.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral is computed from a claim quote and the hedges survive. Four looser points: frame 1's kicker dates MD Anderson via c17 whose text claims more than its quote; frame 8's art joins c8 and c21; frame 2's journal kicker over release copy; the caption narrows the release's stated purpose.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: No place, body or next step, Houston never named, CPRIT unexplained. The only stake is general.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns a swipe and frame 7 is a declared turn. Frames 2 to 5 spend four frames on two method figures. Frame 4 or 5 is cuttable.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and free of house-rule breaks. It doesn't read Texan, 'Drawn to illustrate.' closes seven deks, and the caption describes the deck to the reader.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The first all-relief deck under the studio route, a new palette, a question opening, a research beat rare in the window. The familiar move is the skeleton.

defects_ranked: Frames 4 and 5 grey bar charts on a graph-paper lattice.
No place, body or next step, Houston never named, CPRIT unexplained.
Frames 2 and 3 have no subject at feed size.
Frame 1's coat matte slate, a different material from frame 7's.
Frame 1 kicker dates MD Anderson via c17's text past its quote.
Frame 8 draws exclusion in melanoma and gastric cores, joining c8 and c21.
Frame 2 kicker names the journal over release-sourced copy.
'Drawn to illustrate.' on seven deks and a meta caption line.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey extruded bars on a graph-paper lattice, no pool, no tissue-world material.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove the lattice and build the one and four unit lengths as glass slides laid end to end on the bench, with a raking pool on the fourth slide's cut end.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The same grey chart smaller, a flat mid grey strip across a ruled grid.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Make the 21 a row of the same glass slides and light only the 21st slide's end.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Slides sink into the bench, grey label ends the brightest mass.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the label ends two stops and raise the key's graze on the bevels so each slide gets one bright edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Same as 2, the count's end reads as more dark.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A lit pool where the 37th slide ends.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The coat is a matte slate band, a different surface from frame 7's globule wall.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Re-surface the coat with 4 to 10 px glossy globules, keeping its profile and crop.

one_sentence_fix: Collapse frames 2 to 5 into two built from the deck's tissue materials under a lit pool, and spend the freed frames on a verified Texas stake.
